newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Transmile Group debuts at 12.50 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Transmile Group debuts at 12.50 rgt.

text.p: Malaysian air transport company Transmile Group debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange at 12.50 ringgit on Friday against an offer price of 5.20 ringgit.
The company had offered 6.04 million shares for sale to the public.
Transmile Group is engaged in the air transport of cargo and passengers around Southeast Asia.

In its prospectus for the share issue, Transmile said it had achieved a net profit of 9.87 million ringgit in the year to December 31, 1996. The company said it expected that figure to increase to 13.34 million ringgit in calender 1997.
